description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per check - the payment buys one pre-dispatch check of the arguments blob + tool JSON Schema you submit: verdict VALID, REPAIRED (with the repaired blob and the exact diff), or UNREPAIRABLE (every blocking defect named). Mechanical repairs only (whitelist R1-R9); the service never invents an argument value.

arguments.description: The tool-call arguments blob: a parsed JSON object or the raw JSON text.

schema.description: The tool's JSON Schema (the published subset in the criteria).

name: argument_check_check
